property_summary: For any user who deposited amount x, calling withdrawBalance either pays out and zeroes the balance; if the recipient rejects the payment, the correct contract reverts and the balance is preserved, while the mutant silently zeroes the balance despite the failed payout — so getBalance(user) must equal x after a failed withdrawal attempt, which the mutant violates.
change_summary: Delete the failure check `if (! _s) { revert(); }`, so the balance is zeroed even when the external call fails.
